verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that the Customer.io AI agent can run scheduled recurring tasks such as deliverability reports, and can report on how messages perform. That glances at deliverability monitoring, but nothing documents per-send bounce, complaint, or blocklist metrics. Missing for 10: explicit per-send bounce/complaint/blocklist signals, blocklist monitoring, actionable remediation guidance when deliverability degrades, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
